description: Authoritative control-plane surfaces for multi-replica deployment. Process memory may cache only when class is cache_allowed and a max_stale_ms is set.

classes.shared_store_required: Durable authority lives only in the shared SQLite/PostgreSQL store. Replicas must not decide from process-local state.
classes.cache_allowed: Process-local cache is permitted with max_stale_ms. After the bound, reloads must refuse revoked/widened authority.
classes.process_local_ok: Ephemeral, non-authoritative helper state only. Unsafe as multi-replica authority.

surfaces.notes: Reserve, adjust, and idempotent record must be atomic in the shared store.
Operation receipts and gateway aliases are durable authority.
Authoritative suites/runs/iterations for multi-replica promotion; process-local EvalStore is non-authoritative only.
Portfolio objectives and observations used for routing authority.
Single-winner acquisition and reclaim after owner loss.
PrincipalCredentialStore may cache with CREDENTIAL_CACHE_MAX_STALE_MS; epoch changes reload immediately. Request-path auth rechecks durable rows and never widens authority from cache alone.
Grants and ACL checks resolve against durable store (with optional bounded cache later).
Decisions and object changes are append-only durable evidence.
Gateway may cache last-known governance with TTL; fail-open requires durable local audit spool.
In-memory EvalStore batches for single-process experiments only; not multi-replica authority.
